deduplication: Per session, repeated ordinals are skipped; exact duplicate last+total usage checkpoints are skipped only when cumulative usage is present. Deltas are summed once; reasoning is not added to output.
scope: Only token_count request deltas at/after supervisor-start are counted. Cumulative prior session usage is never charged.

session_role_distinction.preparation_supervision: Root and preparation/coordinator sessions after cutoff; report as supervision/setup overhead, not as primary trajectories.
session_role_distinction.primary_model_task: Named experimental trajectory sessions; aggregate these separately by task/model/effort.
